title: Degree bound for an irreducible polynomial with a root in a finite extension
statement: Let $K\subseteq E$ be fields [def-pc-field-extension], with $E$ finite-dimensional as a $K$-vector space, and write $d=\dim_K E$ [def-weil-vector-space-dimension]. Let $p\in K[X]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] be monic and irreducible (a nonzero nonunit whose every factorization has a unit factor). If $\alpha\in E$ satisfies $p(\alpha)=0$, then $p$ is the minimal polynomial of $\alpha$ over $K$, namely the monic polynomial of least degree vanishing at $\alpha$, and $\deg p\leq d$.
